groups.sentence: Instructors make students aware of the limits of AI-generated content and of prohibited uses such as submitting it as their own.
Instructors may state in their course which uses of AI to produce student work are prohibited.
Students must not use AI to write drafts, sentences, paragraphs or papers, or to generate content for their assignments.
Students must not submit AI-generated work as their own original work, or submit its output unedited.
Submissions wholly or partly AI-generated are not permitted, and students may not paste or incorporate AI output into assignments.
Students must not use AI to complete or solve assignments, problem sets, quizzes or exams.
Students must not use AI to replace their own work, thinking or learning.
Students write and complete their own work themselves, without AI-generated content.
Students must not use AI to generate code.
Students may use AI to help generate drafts, write code, analyze data or build project components.
Submitting AI-produced work as one's own is treated as a violation of academic integrity.
AI-generated output is not the student's own work, and passing it off as theirs is misuse.
Instructors should not allow students to turn in unedited chatbot output as original work.
